title: 日本ダービーの後に・慙愧

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (It's all right! I changed into my backup shoes!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (And I attached my cleats properly! …See, they feel perfectly fine.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (There's nothing off about them…)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (Nothing at all!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: AAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond lets out a fierce roar, as if tearing herself free from something, and kicks off the turf to launch herself out the gates.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And in the front, it's Satono Diamond! This year's Derby champion is Satono Diamond!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond won! Did you see the way she sprinted down the final stretch?!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: It looked like she still had some stamina to spare too! She probably won't have any issues snagging the win at the Kikuka Sho either!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (My shoes were… fine. But even so, they were in the back of my mind the whole time I was running…)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (What a disgraceful performance…)

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Satono Diamond! How does it feel to be crowned a Derby champion?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: …Thank you. It's an honor to have my name etched in Umamusume history.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: This victory here at the Japanese Derby is also a great honor for the Satono family.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I'm sure the Satono Group will be elated by your performance!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes, I believe so too, but I'm also sure they'll also warn me against letting this go to my head.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Oh my! But I'm sure that ambition of yours is what gives you such strength!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It's as you say. I've always been told not to settle for where I am, and to aim for ever greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: To that end, I promise to perform even better at my next race than I did today!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Yeah! That's what we like to hear! You've got this!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I won't disappoint you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Whew…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The tension melts from Satono Diamond the moment she enters the runners' tunnel. Her usual expression returns as she lets out a long sigh.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: …Let's go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: By the time we reach the waiting room, her face has become clouded with displeasure.
choice_data_list: Congratulations on becoming a Derby champion!
Congratulations on becoming a Derby champion!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Thank you. But…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Though I may be a Derby champion, I feel so ashamed of my performance…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: While I was running… all I could think about were my shoes.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Even though they felt totally fine, I couldn't help but check them over and over again!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I… I was afraid of the jinx…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I let it get to me and failed to give my best performance on the track!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I can't forgive myself for that!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I vowed not to let the jinx get the best of me! I swore it, and yet…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: If I am to achieve the Satono family dream, I can't allow even the slightest modicum of doubt to take root in my mind!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: If some formidable jinx tries to block my path, I must acquire the strength to overcome it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'll become so strong that nothing can faze me, so perfectly adapted that nothing can catch me off guard!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: And I'll use that strength to overwhelm any jinx or misfortune that dares get in my way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She gives a refreshing declaration of her intent to succeed. I'm left awestruck.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Earth to Trainer!
choice_data_list: Leave the training schedule to me!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! That's my Trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: We'll show everyone a flawless race at the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I invite Satono Diamond to a cafe on our way back from the racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'd like to treat her to something sweet to give her a boost in her fight to overcome her jinx.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I can order whatever I like? Well, then… Is it okay if I have a fruit parfait topped with cheesecake bites?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: In that case, I'll also have a triple scoop of ice cream on top, with rice flour dumplings, jelly cubes, and some extra fruit…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I don't think the parfait cup will be able to hold anything else. Thanks, Trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just then, we hear someone from a nearby table mention a familiar name.

text_block_list.name: Homebound Male Spectator A
text_block_list.text: The results of the Takarazuka Kinen interim fan vote are out! Kitasan Black is number one!

text_block_list.name: Homebound Male Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I saw! I voted for her too, so I'm super happy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The fans vote to decide who is invited to run in the Takarazuka Kinen. Voting isn't finished yet, but it appears Kitasan Black is the favorite so far.

text_block_list.name: Homebound Male Spectator A
text_block_list.text: She was incredible in the spring Tenno Sho! She was overtaken, but she managed to catch back up and win by a hair's breadth.

text_block_list.name: Homebound Male Spectator B
text_block_list.text: I remember! That was seriously some race! She won that through sheer determination and guts!

text_block_list.name: Homebound Male Spectator A
text_block_list.text: The way she runs with everything she's got, you can't help but root for her. Talk about focus.

text_block_list.name: Homebound Male Spectator B
text_block_list.text: I know what you mean! She's just so down-to-earth and relatable. It's almost like she's one of us regular Joes.

text_block_list.name: Homebound Male Spectator B
text_block_list.text: That's what makes me want her to win! It feels like I've won too when she does!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I feel the same way! Those two understand Kita's strengths so well!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: She prayed for more supporters back when we went to the shrine for New Year's.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It looks like that dream has already come true!
choice_data_list: You mean because she's leading the vote?
You mean because she's leading the vote?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Exactly. On top of that, her fans talk about her so enthusiastically.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: She's getting closer to achieving her other goal of making her fans smile, too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: …I need to step up my game.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I have to become someone worthy of running alongside Kita as her rival!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita might be leagues ahead of me right now, but I'll forge ahead along my own path, and I won't quit until I catch her!
choice_data_list: All the more reason we can't lose the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: That's right. Kita won it last year, so we can't afford to drop the ball on this one!
